cohort: 50 twin pregnancies and 50 singleton pregnancies >28 weeks of gestation at Nalanda Medical College and Hospital, Patna.
finding: Twin pregnancies had a higher risk of maternal complications (anemia, preterm labor, hypertensive disorders, APH) and adverse neonatal outcomes (IUGR, birth weight discordance, early neonatal death, NICU admission) compared to singleton pregnancies.
mod_finding: Cesarean section occurred in 60% of twin pregnancies, most commonly due to malpresentation (24%).
birth_weight: Mean weight of first twin was 2.12+/-0.35 kg and that of second twin was 1.97+/-0.3 kg.
